headline: MCA publishes FAQs on registration of foreign companies and subsidiaries of foreign bodies
summary_points: MCA has reportedly published FAQs on registration of foreign companies in India.
The FAQs also reportedly cover subsidiaries of foreign body corporates.
The report does not give the FAQ contents, a reference number or an effective date.
Details should be confirmed from the MCA website before relying on the clarifications.
who_is_affected: Foreign companies establishing a place of business in India, Indian subsidiaries of foreign body corporates, and the professionals advising them on registration.
action_required: Review the FAQs on the MCA website and check them against your pending or planned foreign company and subsidiary registrations and filings.

- Aligning the documentation with MCA's expectations
- Advising clients on subsidiary set-ups
